TEXT:
[FI] At that moment, the lovely mood around us was 
completely dispelled by the ringing of my phone.
[FI] Ayase's ticked off now, isn't she?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...Onii-san, aren't you picking up your phone?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Ah...

[FI] Pressured by Ayase's threatening attitude, I 
checked my phone's inbox... It's from Kanako?!

[FI] Her absolutely awful timing was making my head 
hurt. As for what she wants--

SPEAKER: SPK_KANAKO
TEXT:
[FI] Hey Manager, you free? 'Course you're free. I need 
some advice.
[FI] --is what she said.

[FI] The way she's using me like some servant, I wonder 
if she's misunderstood something?

[FI] Anyway, I replied saying I'm busy right now but I'll 
hear her out later, and closed my phone.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] ...So, who was it from?

[FI] At that moment, I swear I could hear the very air 
freezing around us.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Um, Ayase-san...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, Onii-san, won't you tell me?

[FI] Don't say that with a smile like that on your face! 
It's scary!
[FI] ...Well, it's nothing I need to hide anyway.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's from Kanako. Want to see?

[FI] As I said that, I took out my phone and presented 
it to Ayase.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, no, I wouldn't...

[FI] With that, Ayase pushed my phone back to me 
with a troubled expression.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You sure?

[FI] I think it'd be better for her to clear up any doubts 
if it's bothering her that much.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It's okay. I trust you, Onii-san.
[FI] It didn't seem like it just a moment ago though.
[FI] Well, if Ayase says so, I guess it's fine.

[FI] I put my phone away and tried to improve the 
mood again.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] Oh, right! There's an ice cream stand with delicious 
ice cream near here!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'll go buy some, then.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] No, I'll go by myself. You can just wait here, 
Onii-san.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, I should go with--

[FI] Ayase raised a finger to silence my lips, giving me a 
radiant smile.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] It's okay. Just promise you'll welcome me back 
with a smile once I return, okay?

[FI] As Ayase said that, she rushed out of the park 
without waiting for my reply.

[FI] Well, Ayase is more at home in Odaiba than I am, 
so the best decision here is to leave it to her.

[FI] ...Still, as a guy, this is rather vexing, I better reflect 
on this when I get back home.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Sorry to keep you waiting.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Oh, that was quick... Wait, why only one?

[FI] I asked out of curiosity as I saw her carrying only 
one ice cream in her hand.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] I thought we might share it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?

[FI] Following which, she took a bite of the ice cream. 
You're adorable like that, but didn't you just say 
something very odd, Ayase-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Here you go, Onii-san.

[FI] At that moment, I must've died at least three times. 
I mean, I could see my whole life pass before my 
eyes.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] U-Um, Onii-san?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, it's nothing. What were you saying again?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I was just saying that we should eat this ice cream 
together.

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT:
[FI] I-I'm often eating ice cream with Kirino, but... as a 
couple, is it that strange?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I-It's not strange at all!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Thank goodness...

[FI] Ayase was still holding the ice cream out towards 
me.
[FI] No other choice then, I'm taking a bite.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's sweet...

[FI] I think I wanted to say something more, but that 
notion was blown away instantly.
[FI] I mean, this is... 'that', isn't it? An indirect kiss...!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] It's okay if you want some more.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] *gasp*

[FI] That's when I noticed. I couldn't help but notice. 
There's some ice cream stuck to her cheek...!!
[FI] I-Is she doing that on purpose?!

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Hm? Is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, there's some... on your cheek...

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Ah!

[FI] As I pointed it out, Ayase got a bit flustered and 
hurriedly wiped her face with a handkerchief.
[FI] Nope. I regret nothing, okay?

SPEAKER: SPK_AYASE
TEXT: [FI] P-Please say that sooner, geez...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] A-Ah, sorry...

[FI] I tried to calm my frantically beating heart while 
eating the rest of the ice cream with Ayase.

[FI] Right now, anyone who saw us would think we're 
madly in love... Well, it's the truth though.
